author: Written down by a traveler, as spoken by Deeja-Sleeps
pages:
#The Trees

The Hist are trees. The Hist are not trees. Every Argonian is born beneath one and licks its sap as a hatchling, and the Hist chooses what that one will become.

Outlanders think this is strange. Argonians think it is strange to be born without anyone deciding anything.

#Memory

The Hist remember everything that has ever happened in the marsh, all at once. When the Hist speaks, it does not tell you a story. It shows you a moment, and you are inside it.

This is why Argonians are patient. They have already seen the ending.
